newsitem.title: USA: Morgan Stanley closes $800 mln capital pool.
newsitem.headline: Morgan Stanley closes $800 mln capital pool.

text.p: Morgan Stanley said on Wednesday it closed Princes Gate Investors II, L.P., a private equity investment pool with $800 million in capital, to new investors.
Princes Gate II is designed to facilitate the strategic and financial objectives of companies by making investments in or with them, Morgan Stanley said in a statement.
It succeeded Prince Gate Investors L.P., which was formed in 1992 and expired earlier this year, the company said.

"Princes Gate is unique among private equity funds, given our short to medium term focus and the fact that we generally make non-controlling investments," Hartley Rogers, managing director and head of Princes Gate's general partner, said in a statement.
Princes Gate II has 16 limited partners, including Morgan Stanley as general partner and manager. The other partners are private investment groups and wealthy individuals, it said.
Princes Gate II has already agreed to make three investments totalling over $60 million, Morgan said.
